# ForgeFlow Offboarding / Return / Deletion Acknowledgement

**Legal Pack Version:** `2026-09-IR-2`

Acceptance of the ForgeFlow Legal Pack includes agreement to complete reasonable offboarding obligations when private ForgeFlow access ends.

## Owner-side offboarding

The Founder should, as applicable:

- revoke GitHub private repository access;
- revoke deployment, cloud, CI/CD and package-registry access;
- revoke active sessions, SSH keys or app passwords where applicable;
- rotate shared or exposed credentials where required;
- transfer open PRs, branches, issues and operational responsibilities;
- update the private access record with the revocation date.

## Developer confirmation

When requested at the end of access, the Developer should confirm that they have:

- stopped using ForgeFlow private systems and credentials;
- returned or permanently deleted ForgeFlow private source code, documents, exports, credentials and Confidential Information in their possession or control, except copies legally required to be retained or ordinary immutable backups not reasonably accessible in normal use;
- preserved the confidentiality of any legally retained copy and not used it for another purpose;
- returned Founder/ForgeFlow-owned devices, hardware, tokens or property, if any;
- disclosed unresolved security incidents, credential exposures or confidential-data disclosures known to them;
- transferred active work reasonably needed for continuity.

Confidentiality, economic-rights allocation, licensing and other obligations intended by their nature to survive continue after access ends to the extent provided by applicable law and agreement.

## Suggested electronic completion record

When offboarding occurs, the Founder may request the Developer to post or electronically sign a separate completion statement. The preferred record is kept in a private legal/HR system rather than in the source repository when it contains personal or sensitive information.

A repository comment, if used, should contain no confidential details and may use:

`I confirm completion of the ForgeFlow offboarding, return and deletion obligations applicable to my access.`

This document is an operational acknowledgement and does not prevent the Founder from using a dedicated e-signature service for a stronger evidentiary record.
